text:
alex: kicking off config-only change v2.2.0-alpha-batch. goal: reduce burst_shaper, tighten per-tenant soft_qps, shorten batching_window, enable kv_prefetch for canary. change window 09:00-10:00 UTC.
deploybot: canary rollout initiated to 2% traffic (canary-tenants tag). canary start ts 5901234569. monitoring p95/p99, errors, kvcache pressure.
tara: please hold initial ramp until cross-region config sync job finishes (~09:05 UTC). demo tenant edge-labs is in the 09:10 demo path.
mike: suggest pin top noisy tenants to spare pool during canary: `pin_tenants: ["big-co","edge-labs","acme-edge"]` -> routing class "spare". reduces noisy neighbor risk.
nina: rollback criteria: p99 > 600ms for >90s OR error_rate > 0.3%. Rollback target is v2.1.9. Also require kvcache_warmup_ttl 5m post-rollback.
ops-oncall: ack. setting ephemeral alerts: p99_tail > 600ms || kvcache_evictions/min > 60 -> page. will enable verbose logs for canary group.
deploybot: canary snapshot @5901234579: p95 baseline 210ms -> canary 230ms, p99 baseline 480ms -> canary 510ms, errors 0.01%, kvcache_evictions 8/min.
alex: applying canary-only tweaks: `batch_window_ms: 6 -> 3`, `burst_shaper_tokens: 5000 -> 3500`, `soft_qps_per_tenant: 1000 -> 750`, `kv_prefetch: true`, `dedupe_quorum: 2`.
mike: also reduce `batch_max_tokens` for canary to lower mem pressure: 4096 -> 2560. snippet for ops: ```json
{"batching": {"max_tokens": 2560, "window_ms": 3}, "limits": {"soft_qps_per_tenant": 750}, "routing": {"pin_tenants": ["big-co","edge-labs"]}}
```
tara: holding for manual go at 09:05 UTC. please don't auto-ramp beyond 2% until I ack.
deploybot: ramp paused at 2% pending manual approval.
ops-oncall: adding runbook step: on rollback, unroute canary shards -> revert config -> clear/preload kvcache -> monitor for 10m. assigning owners: mike(step1), nina(step2), ops-oncall(step3).
nina: prepping rollback playbook details and one-click revert job. will add tag `rollback_target:v2.1.9` and `keep_prev_for:24h` on routes.
mike: small operational note: set `kv_prefetch_batch_size` to 128 for canary to avoid spike.
deploybot: scheduled conditional ramp to 10% at 5901234600 (manual go/no-go).
tara: product approves demo path for edge-labs. :white_check_mark:
alex: final state: canary live at 2%, cross-region sync pending, manual gate at 09:05 for 10% ramp. post here with go/no-go.
ops-oncall: standing by on pager. will escalate if thresholds breached.
deploybot: end of automated updates. will log final snapshot when ramp occurs.
alex: end of thread  will post go/no-go at 09:05 UTC.
